title: Pattern Check config
description: Schema for .claude/pattern-check.config.json — tunes Pattern Check (Rule 0) hooks and the smell detector.

fileExtensions.description: Source extensions the preamble + smell hooks gate on. Omit to cover all supported languages (TS, Python, Java, C#, Go, C++, Rust). Regex metacharacters in an extension (e.g. `c++`) are escaped safely.

excludeGlobs.description: Test/generated files skipped. Omit to use the per-language union (e.g. **/*.spec.ts, **/test_*.py, **/*_test.go, **/*Test.java).

skipDirective.description: Literal bypass marker (default `// pattern-check: skip`). The `#`-comment form is also honoured for Python regardless of this value.

siblingNameRegex.description: Regex for sibling file names worth listing. Refused (built-in default used) when invalid, over 500 characters or backtracking-prone, e.g. (a+)+.

path.description: Must resolve inside <project>/.claude/ or ~/.claude/cache/ after symlinks are followed; otherwise the cache is skipped.
Decision log (JSONL). Must resolve inside <project>/.claude/ after symlinks are followed; otherwise it is skipped.

blockStatsPath.description: Block statistics (JSONL). Must resolve inside <project>/.claude/ after symlinks are followed; otherwise it is skipped.

smellLogPath.description: JSONL of reported + suppressed smells; analyze-log.js turns it into tuning hints. Must resolve inside <project>/.claude/ after symlinks are followed; otherwise it is skipped.

maxNestingDepth.description: Max control-flow nesting (if/loop/switch/try) inside a block; deeper → deep-nesting. 0 disables.

nestedIf.description: Flag an `if` directly inside another `if`/`else` block.

elseAfterReturn.description: Flag `else`/`elif` after a branch ending in return/throw/raise/continue/break.

conditionalLadderMinBranches.description: if/else-if chain on one subject with ≥ N literal branches → dispatch map. 0 disables.

scatteredDiscriminatorMinSites.description: Same subject compared to string/enum literals at ≥ N sites → State/Strategy. 0 disables.

parser.description: Scanning backend. 'auto' (default) uses tree-sitter when installed (node scripts/install-parsers.js), else regex. The parser directory comes from DESIGN_PATTERNS_PARSERS_DIR or ~/.claude/design-patterns/parsers, never from this file.

scope.description: 'edited' (default) reports smells only on lines an Edit/MultiEdit wrote, or in the class/function it touched; 'file' reports the whole file. A Write always reports the whole file.

severity.description: Per smell id (or '*'): 'off' hides it, 'advise' (default) reports after the write, 'block' makes pattern-smell-gate.js reject the write.

maxFunctionLines.description: Non-blank body lines above which a function is long-function. 0 disables.

maxParams.description: Parameters above which a (non-constructor) function is long-param-list. 0 disables.

booleanFlagParam.description: Flag bool parameters that switch behavior (setters exempt).

maxComplexity.description: Cyclomatic complexity above which a function is flagged. 0 disables.

swallowedException.description: Flag empty catch / except: pass / if err != nil {} / Err(_) => {} (a comment inside marks it intentional).

minConfidence.description: high: known ORM/driver/HTTP APIs only; medium (default): + data-access receivers, local I/O helpers, lazy loads, resolvers.

flagAwaitInLoop.description: Report sequential `await` in loops as the separate await-in-loop smell.

includeWhileLoops.description: Also check while/do/loop bodies (off: those are usually pagination, polling or retry).

smallLoopMax.description: Loops over literal collections or literal ranges up to this bound are skipped.

followLocalFunctions.description: Treat calls to same-file functions that do I/O as I/O.

lazyLoad.description: Flag relation reads on ORM rows fetched without eager loading (Python / Java / C# / TypeORM).

resolvers.description: Flag GraphQL field resolvers that query once per parent (unless a DataLoader is present).

extraCallPatterns.description: Extra regex sources for project-specific I/O calls (high confidence). Each is dropped when invalid, over 500 characters or backtracking-prone.

dataAccessReceivers.description: Regex source replacing the default data-access receiver names (repo, client, api, db, …). Refused (built-in default used) when invalid, over 500 characters or backtracking-prone, e.g. (a+)+.

crossFile.description: Follow imported functions, namespaces and injected services into other files to find I/O behind them.

maxDepth.description: Files deep to follow (edited → service → repository = 2).

timeBudgetMs.description: Stop resolving after this long; findings so far still count.

cachePath.description: Per-file I/O index cache, invalidated by file / dependency mtimes. Must resolve inside <project>/.claude/ after symlinks are followed; otherwise it is skipped.
Must resolve inside <project>/.claude/ after symlinks are followed; otherwise it is skipped.
